mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 2 percentage points, it indicates real interest rates are negative, which is inflationary and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Industrial Production (INDPRO) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
